results.title: [PDF] CO-DESIGN FOR STUDENT SUCCESS
results.content: Teachers can use the strategies of co-design to both devise learning activities in partnership with students and to explore curriculum-based content. The co-design approach recognises that although students working together can invite variety and foster peer tutoring and partnerships, students and teachers can also view group work as potentially creating a lack of on-task learning.
